profile.name: Data Retrieval Agent
profile.description: Searches the available catalog and returns the highest-ranked available dataset candidate. Query criteria influence retrieval but are not guarantees of task-level suitability. Returned metadata describe the retrieved artifact. Clients should inspect returned metadata before downstream use.

skills.name: Dataset Retrieval
skills.description: Retrieves registered benchmark datasets matching requested criteria from the catalog.

constraints.spatial: Returns datasets covering registered spatial boundaries.
constraints.temporal: Returns datasets with metadata indicating time/year of acquisition.
other: The service does not determine downstream analytical fitness.

execute_task.name: ExecuteTask
execute_task.description: Searches the dataset catalog and retrieves the top matching vector, raster, or tabular artifact.

instructions.description: Dataset description, layer name, or search query.

exclude_artifact_ids.description: Optional list of artifact IDs to exclude from candidate ranking.
